aggregate.averaging: equal fold, equal seed; each run uses mean volume Dice
aggregate.limitation: Exploratory extension requested after observing three-fold outcomes. All prior folds, including the negative fold, are retained. Four fold blocks and no verified patient mapping cannot establish patient-independent significance.
aggregate.statistical_note: Repeated case/seed predictions are not independent. With 4 fold blocks, the minimum two-sided exact sign-flip p-value is 0.125. Bootstrap intervals are exploratory, not a significance declaration.
